name: com.phytrisha.studio-pipeline
description: Editor side of the blender-unity-game-studio art pipeline: ProjectPaths (where assets live), AssetImportRules (import settings for SM_/SK_/T_ files from Blender), AssetPipeline (materials, LOD prefabs, UCX colliders, animator controllers, scene problems), ProjectSetup (URP, linear, Force Text) and the PerfBench runtime benchmark.
